title: Sr. Data Analytics Engineer
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay . CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job

We are looking for someone to join Credix as a a Senior Analytics Engineer . You will take ownership of structuring our data analytics platform and analytics use-cases. You love to tackle big problems and break them down into smaller pieces. You will build an analytics platform that features reliable, timely and understandable metrics in a slice-and-dice format to empower other teams to make better decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain dbt models and reliable datasets that power analytics, experiments, and decision-making across the company.
  • Define and act upon standards for metrics, data modeling practices, and documentation.
  • Oversee the full analytics lifecycle, from transforming raw to delivering insights in BI platforms (e.g. Hex).
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering to ensure analytics pipelines meet high standards of quality, observability and testing.
  • Enable self-service analytics by creating semantic layers and reusable data assets that let teams create insights independently.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related technical data role.
  • Deep expertise with SQL and dbt, including modular modeling, documentation, and testing.
  • Proven track record of building source-of-truth data models that support product use cases.
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses (BigQuery), semantic layers (dbt), version control (Git), and visualization tools (Hex).
  • Experience in a (credit) FinTech is a must.
  • Manager of one: structuring, and executing upon the analytics roadmap.
  • Analytical and system-oriented mindset with a strong problem-solving ability to handle complex data challenges.
  • Proactive, clear and concise communication both in Portuguese and English, ensuring alignment with cross-functional teams.
  • Anticipate business metrics needs and structure the analytics layer to ensure scalability and reusability across the entire company.
  • High attention to detail and a perfectionist approach, especially in maintaining metrics quality and integrity.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, startup environment.
  • Genuine interest/passion for disrupting the B2B credit market in Brazil by using data.
  • Collaborative mindset, working effectively with diverse stakeholders.

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

- A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies

- Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.

- Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.

- Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate

- Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

  • Experience in banking / capital markets / trading environments

title: Head of Gaming, Brazil
description:
At bet365, we're one of the world's leading online gambling companies, revolutionising the industry since 2000. Founded by Denise Coates CBE, we now employ over 9,000 people and serve over 100 million customers in 27 languages. Our focus on In-Play betting has solidified our market-leading position, offering an unmatched experience across 96 sports and 700,000 streaming events. With over 750 concurrent sporting fixtures at peak and more live sports streamed than anyone else in Europe, we handle over 6 billion requests daily and process more than 2 million bets per hour at peak.

We empower our employees to push boundaries and explore new ideas, cultivating a culture that celebrates and rewards creativity. This offers employees a wealth of opportunities for growth, giving them the opportunity to make a real impact in the world of online gambling. As a forward-thinking company, we’re breaking new ground in software innovation too, redefining what’s possible for our customers worldwide.

Job Description

As the Head of Gaming, Brazil, you will lead strategic initiatives to enhance our gaming portfolio across Casino, Live Casino, Poker, and Bingo and will be responsible for the financial performance of gaming operations in the region, executing the strategy set by the CPO and ensuring alignment with the overall business strategy, while maximising player engagement and revenue growth.

We are looking for a dynamic and experienced leader with a proven track record in the iGaming industry who possesses strong commercial acumen, exceptional leadership skills, and a deep understanding of what makes an exceptional localised Gaming Product.

You will develop and execute a comprehensive gaming strategy tailored to the Brazilian market, collaborating closely with the central Product team. This strategy will aim to achieve set financial targets for Casino, Live Casino, Poker, and Bingo in each market.

Your role will involve identifying growth opportunities and ensuring the delivery of product and content roadmaps in the region. You will leverage customer and data insights to inform strategies, working with marketing and CRM teams to ensure their approaches align with key product initiatives. Additionally, you will build and mentor a high-performing team, fostering a culture of excellence and accountability.

Qualifications

  • Significant experience in a senior role within the iGaming industry.
  • Proven track record of driving revenue growth and operational excellence.
  • In-depth knowledge of games and game types within Casino, Live Casino, Poker, and Bingo.
  • Exceptional leadership and team management skills.
  • Experience in product development and lifecycle management.
  • Excellent analytical and strategic thinking abilities.
  • Strong negotiation skills and experience with supplier management.
  • Ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders.
  • Passion for innovation and enhancing player experiences.
  • Familiarity with market research and competitive analysis.

Additional Information

  • Developing and executing a comprehensive gaming strategy tailored to Brazil while ensuring it meets and exceeds financial targets for gaming revenue.
  • Identifying and evaluating growth opportunities, including new market expansions, partnerships, and product offerings.
  • Developing and executing a commercial strategy that aligns with regional objectives, working closely with central commercial teams to maximise revenue opportunities.
  • Overseeing the end-to-end product lifecycle for gaming offerings, working with the central Product teams to ensure that products are tailored to meet market preferences and requirements.
  • Establishing clear milestones and timelines for game releases, updates, and integrations, ensuring projects are delivered on time and to a high quality.
  • Collaborating with Marketing and CRM teams to optimise player engagement and offers, and design tailored promotions and rewards for players in Brazil.
  • Leveraging customer and data insights to inform strategies and decision-making, and conducting market research and competitive analysis to inform product development and identify emerging trends and customer needs.
  • Building, leading, and mentoring a high-performing gaming team, fostering a culture of collaboration.
  • Taking responsibility for the financial performance of Gaming in the region, ensuring that revenue targets are met and profitability is maximised, while regularly reporting performance metrics to the CPO and other key stakeholders.
  • Serving as the voice of the customer, ensuring Gaming products address player needs.

title: AI-First Frontend Engineer (Next.js & React) - Remote
description:
About LumiMeds

LumiMeds is a fast-growing U.S.-based telehealth startup focused on weight management and long-term metabolic health. We are building the next generation of e-commerce and clinical infrastructure from the ground up.

As an early-stage company, we move quickly, operate with limited layers, and expect high ownership from every team member. There is no bureaucracy here — decisions happen fast, priorities evolve, and builders thrive.

We are a remote-first, globally distributed team that values clarity, accountability, and people who take initiative rather than wait for direction.

Location: Remote / Hybrid - we accept candidates located across LATAM, South America, Europe

Seniority: Mid-Level / Senior (Individual Contributor)

Role Overview

LumiMeds is a high-growth telehealth platform building the next generation of virtual telehealth infrastructure. We are looking for an AI-First Frontend Engineer who builds beautiful, performant, and clinically reliable interfaces —and uses AI to do it at a pace that consistently surprises people.

You are not a designer who codes, nor a utility developer who ships components on request. You are an engineer who can translate a Figma frame into a pixel-perfect, highly performant Next.js experience, architect the state model behind it, and use AI tooling to compress a week of work into a day. You know how to direct Claude agent teams to handle parallelizable work — generating component variants, writing test suites, auditing accessibility — so you can stay focused on the decisions that require human judgment. You will balance 90% hands-on codingwith 10% mentorship, and you are expected to set the bar for frontend quality and velocity on the team.

Core Technical Domains

You will own the user-facing layer across our consumer and clinical platforms:

  • Performant Marketing & E-commerce: Engineering lightning-fast, SEO-optimized storefronts and landing pages. You treat Core Web Vitals as a first-class deliverable.
  • Clinical Web Application (EMR & Provider Portal): Building the “Clinical OS” — complex, state-heavy interfaces where data integrity and reliability are non-negotiable.
  • AI-Powered UI Features: Implementing streaming LLM responses, real-time clinical summaries, and conversational interfaces embedded into patient and provider flows.
  • Virtual Care Interfaces: Implementing WebRTC video components, real-time secure messaging, and low-latency async consultation flows.
  • Design System & Motion: Maintaining a component library using Framer Motion to produce purposeful animations that make the platform feel premium and intuitive.

Key Responsibilities

  • AI-Augmented Frontend Development: Use Cursor, Copilot, and LLMs as first-class tools to generate components, write tests, and iterate on UI logic at high velocity. Prompt quality is part of the craft.
  • Claude Agent Team Orchestration: Coordinate Claude agent teams via the Claude Agent SDK to execute parallelizable frontend work — generating component variants, writing test suites, auditing accessibility, and producing design-to-code translations at scale. You know how to structure agent prompts, verify outputs, and integrate agent-generated code into the production codebase reliably.
  • Aesthetic Engineering: Translate high-fidelity Figma designs into pixel-perfect, responsive experiences that hold visual integrity across all device sizes and breakpoints.
  • Performance Ownership: Own Core Web Vitals — optimize LCP, INP, and bundle size. Understand hydration, streaming SSR, and caching strategies at a deep level.
  • AI UI Integration: Build and maintain frontend interfaces that consume LLM outputs — streaming text, structured responses, tool-call results — in ways that feel fluid and reliable to end users.
  • State Architecture: Design resilient client-side state capable of handling real-time clinical data, optimistic updates, and complex form flows across the patient journey.
  • Compliance & Security: Ensure all interfaces meet HIPAA/SOC2 standards, with a focus on secure data handling, audit trails, and PII protection.

Required Hard Skills & Tech Stack

  • Next.js Mastery: Expert-level knowledge of the App Router, Server Components (RSC), and sophisticated caching/streaming strategies.
  • The “Beautiful Web” Stack: Expert proficiency in Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion for fluid, high-end interfaces.
  • Performance Optimization: Proven track record optimizing bundle sizes, hydration cycles, and Lighthouse scores.
  • State Management: Expertise in TanStack Query (server state) and Zustand (client state).
  • LLM UI Patterns: Experience building streaming response UIs, chat interfaces, or AI-assisted input flows using OpenAI or Anthropic APIs.
  • Claude Agent Teams: Hands-on experience building and directing Claude agent teams using the Claude Agent SDK — from bulk component generation to automated visual regression and test coverage. You can design an agent pipeline, define subagent roles, and validate the output before it lands in production.
  • AI Dev Tooling: Daily active use of Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent. Strong opinions on how to use AI for component generation, refactoring, and test writing.
  • Browser Fundamentals: Deep understanding of the DOM, rendering pipeline, and HIPAA-compliant data handling in the browser.

Candidate Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional frontend engineering experience.
  • AI-Native Workflow: You can demonstrate concretely how AI has accelerated your frontend output. Examples or portfolio required.
  • The Dual-Threat Portfolio: Proven experience building both visually polished, high-traffic marketing sites and complex, data-driven SaaS applications.
  • Uncompromising Eye for Detail: You notice when spacing is off by 2px and care enough to fix it. Typography, micro-interactions, and motion are part of your craft.
  • High Agency: Ability to self-direct, operate in ambiguity, and make high-leverage frontend decisions without constant supervision.
  • Communication: Professional proficiency in English for technical documentation and cross-functional collaboration.

Why Join LumiMeds?

  • AI as Infrastructure: We don’t bolt AI on — it’s embedded in how we build. You’ll be encouraged and expected to use every tool available to ship faster and better.
  • Design-Forward Culture: We believe healthcare should be beautiful. You’ll have the technical freedom to build a premium brand experience without compromise.
  • Direct Impact: Fast, intuitive, and beautiful interfaces directly affect patient outcomes and provider efficiency.

title: Sr. AI Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)

Please upload your CV Resume in English.

﻿

Monthly salary: $5,000 - $6,500 USD

Along with our partner, we are seeking an engineer who takes prototypes to production: hardening, deploying, iterating with real users, and owning the full delivery pipeline. You’re the person who makes AI products real.

The role:

They have prototypes that work. What they don’t have is a dedicated engineer to take them to production. You’ll take existing foundations, harden them into production-grade applications, deploy them, and iterate based on real user feedback. You’ll also prototype new AI-powered features and capabilities alongside your director.

This is an engineering execution role, not a product management role. You’ll make technical decisions about AI behavior, implement LLM tool-use flows for non-technical hotel operators, and own the entire delivery pipeline from working prototype to deployed, monitored, production application.

What you’ll do:

  • Take prototypes to production.  The prototypes exist a conversational BI tool with NL2SQL and a portfolio-level operations dashboard. You’ll add auth, monitoring, error handling, test coverage, and deploy them for real users.
  • Own AI engineering decisions.  Implement how the LLM interacts with users tool-use flows, NL2SQL generation, streaming UX, error recovery, conversation lifecycle. You have opinions about this, not just implementation skills.
  • Build full-stack.  Angular 19/21, Fastify 5, TypeScript end-to-end. Frontend components, API routes, Snowflake queries you move across the stack as needed.
  • Harden and deploy.  CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps), Azure AD authentication, error handling, test coverage, performance optimization. Make prototypes production-safe.
  • Close the loop with stakeholders.  Work with their director and the product team to translate user feedback into engineering iterations. You won’t be customer-facing, but you’ll be close to the feedback and responsible for acting on it.
  • Manage and extend the verified query set.  Their NL2SQL accuracy is powered by example-led generation a curated library of verified queries that constrain LLM output. You’ll add to it, run gap analyses, and use it as the primary lever for improving answer accuracy.
  • Close the feedback loop.  User signals acknowledgments, ratings, corrections feed back into system quality. You’ll design pipelines that route those signals to verified query sets, prompt refinement, or evaluation frameworks so the system improves measurably with use.
  • Work with AI agents.  Their development workflow uses Claude Code with specialist AI agents, CLAUDE.md-driven conventions, and Design → Build → Review pipelines. You’ll adopt and improve this system.

Tech you’ll work with:

  • Application layer:  TypeScript, Angular 19/21, Fastify 5, Node.js, React
  • Monorepo and standalone app structures. SSE streaming, Zustand/NgRx state management, ECharts, Material UI.
  • AI / LLM integration:  Gemini (Vertex AI), Claude API, Tool-use patterns, SSE streaming, MCP (Model Context Protocol)
  • Text-to-Specification patterns the LLM classifies and parameterizes against a semantic layer rather than writing raw SQL. dbt semantic layer for metric definitions and dimension catalogs. MCP server architecture serving data retrieval across multiple products.
  • Data layer:  Snowflake, dbt, Data Vault 2.0
  • You don’t need to be a data engineer, but you’ll write Snowflake queries and understand the Data Vault model backing their analytics.
  • Infrastructure:  Azure, Azure DevOps, Azure AD
  • CI/CD pipelines, cloud hosting, SSO authentication. You’ll own the path from merged PR to running in production.

What they’re looking for:

Must-haves

  • AI engineering experience. You’ve built and shipped applications that use LLMs not just wrappers around ChatGPT, but real tool-use flows, structured generation, or agent systems.
  • You have opinions about when to stream vs. batch, when to ask for clarification vs. infer, and how to handle LLM errors gracefully.
  • Full-stack TypeScript. Strong in Angular (their primary customer-facing framework). React experience is a plus but Angular is the requirement. Solid Node.js/Fastify backend skills. You can own a feature from database query to rendered UI.
  • Production shipping muscle. You’ve taken something from “it works on my machine” to “it’s running in production with real users.” CI/CD, monitoring, auth, error handling the foundational work that makes software real.
  • Direct communication. You ask questions before building. You push back on vague requirements. You say “this seems wrong” when it does. No yes-people.
  • AI agent systems experience. You’ve built, managed, or worked extensively with AI agent systems multi-agent orchestration, tool-use pipelines, or agentic development workflows. Their entire dev process runs through 30+ specialist AI agents; you need to be comfortable operating in and improving that system.
  • AI-assisted development. Comfortable working with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, etc.) as a core part of your workflow, not a novelty.
  • Multi-tenant AI safety. You understand the difference between enforcing data isolation at the LLM layer (fragile) versus the data connection layer (robust) and why that distinction matters when customer data can never cross boundaries.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Hospitality industry experience or multi-property portfolio analytics
  • Snowflake / SQL analytics experience
  • Experience with SSE or WebSocket-based real-time UX
  • Azure cloud platform experience
  • LLM observability and evaluation frameworks (LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, or similar) instrumenting AI pipelines to track faithfulness and relevancy, not just uptime

How our partner works:

Their development workflow is AI-native. They use Claude Code with 30+ specialist AI agents, CLAUDE.md project conventions, and a Design → Build → Review pipeline. Every feature goes through product design agents before coding and security + QA agents after. This isn’t optional it’s how they ship quality at speed with a small team.

  • Small team, high autonomy. You report directly to the Director of Data Engineering. Minimal process, maximum ownership.
  • Real data only. No mock data in any environment. APIs return errors when Snowflake is down, not fake arrays. Empty states say “not yet available,” not fake numbers.
  • Documentation as code. CLAUDE.md files, architecture docs, and API route docs are living documents that stay in sync with the codebase.
  • Quality gates. Security review + QA review after every implementation round. Non-negotiable.

Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to build production-grade AI products at the forefront of agent-driven technology.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.

*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Collections Analyst
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay . CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the Job

We're looking for a Collections Agent to join our Operations Team. As a Collections Agent you will be responsible for executing hands-on collections activities to ensure timely recovery of overdue payments while maintaining professional relationships with SME customers. You will work directly with active cases, contacting customers and following up on overdue payments. The role plays a key part in reducing early-stage delinquency and supporting healthy cash flow across Credix’s portfolio.

Qualifications

  • 1–2 year of experience in collections, accounts receivable, customer service, call centers, or operational roles.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Comfortable communicating with customers via phone, WhatsApp, and email.
  • The ability to handle multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working with basic data (SQL), Excel, internal tools, and spreadsheets.
  • Willingness to learn and grow within the role.
  • Collaborative mindset work seamlessly with cross-functional teams.
  • Interest in fintech, operations, or financial services.

Responsibilities

  • Contact customers according to defined schedules and scripts via phone, WhatsApp, and email.
  • Develop and utilize communication scripts to negotiate.
  • Follow up on overdue payments and payment promises, ensuring timely actions aligned with the delinquency cycle (e.g., DPD+3, DPD+7).
  • Provide repayment options to improve the borrower experience.
  • Accurately log all payment information, customer interactions, agreements, and outcomes in internal systems.
  • Support the team with day-to-day operational tasks related to collections.
  • Escalate cases per internal policies and flag recurring issues, customer objections, or process gaps to the Collections Specialist.
  • Prepare daily and weekly reports on recovery rates, DPD trends, and case resolutions, generating actionable insights to improve collection strategies.
  • Automate repetitive tasks using tools like SQL to identify inefficiencies and implement workflows that improve process efficiency.

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

  • Padronização de descrições e títulos
  • Inferência e sugestão de atributos
  • Classificação e reclassificação de produtos
  • Atuar na definição e otimização de:
  • Modelos e regras de categorização de produtos
  • Estratégias de enriquecimento e validação automática de atributos

  • Traduzir problemas de negócio e operacionais em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados escaláveis.

  • Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento das soluções baseadas em IA.

Requisitos necessários:

  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.
  • Experiência prática com problemas de classificação, enriquecimento ou qualidade de dados.
  • Forte domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem.
  • Experiência com modelos de machine learning aplicados a dados estruturados.
  • Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto digital.
  • Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex: BigQuery, data lakes).
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume e complexidade de dados.
  • Noções de MLOps.
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia com catálogo de produtos, e-commerce ou marketplace.
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados e governança de dados.

title: Especialista de engenharia de dados
description:
Sobre a vaga:

O Candidato de Staff Data Engineer, ficará alocado(a) no Banco John Deere, você será responsável por atuar como liderança técnica da plataforma de dados, definindo arquitetura, padrões e boas práticas de engenharia de dados que garantam escala, governança, confiabilidade e sustentabilidade das soluções de dados. Você atuará de forma transversal, apoiando múltiplos times e produtos, sendo referência técnica em decisões estratégicas de dados, trabalhando em parceria com Engineering Managers, Product Managers e áreas de negócio. As responsabilidades de Staff Data Engineer incluem:

  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura da plataforma de dados, incluindo ingestão, transformação, armazenamento e consumo;
  • Estabelecer padrões técnicos e boas práticas de engenharia de dados para uso por múltiplos times;
  • Atuar como referência técnica para engenheiros de dados, apoiando decisões arquiteturais e promovendo mentoria;
  • Conduzir decisões técnicas relacionadas a escalabilidade, custo, governança, qualidade e confiabilidade dos dados;
  • Trabalhar de forma próxima a Engineering Managers e Product Managers para alinhar soluções de dados às necessidades do negócio e requisitos regulatórios;
  • Resolver problemas técnicos complexos e sistêmicos que impactam múltiplos pipelines, domínios ou produtos de dados;
  • Contribuir para a evolução contínua da estratégia de dados do Banco John Deere.

Requisitos:

  • Graduação completa ou equivalente em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência mínima em progressiva em engenharia de dados, com trajetória consistente;
  • Experiência comprovada em mentoria e liderança técnica de outros engenheiros;
  • Atuar como autoridade técnica na resolução de problemas complexos de engenharia de dados;
  • Conhecimento de Arquitetura e Plataforma de Dados;
  • Experiência com Engenharia e Processamento de Dados (ingestão, transformação, orquestração, processamento em larga escala);
  • Conhecimento em Governança, Qualidade, Lineage, Segurança e Conformidade de Dados;
  • Domínio avançado de Cloud e Infraestrutura para Dados (plataformas em cloud, otimização de custos, resiliência operacional);
  • Domínio avançado de AWS (Amazon Web Services), com foco em S3 (Simple Storage Service) e Data Lake;
  • Experiência com AWS DMS (Data Migration Service);
  • Experiência com Databricks e Apache Spark;
  • Conhecimento de SQL (Structured Query Language) avançado e Bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, AWS);
  • Experiência com Modelagem e transformação de dados para consumo analítico;
  • Conhecimento em Escalabilidade e estratégias de entrega de dados (batch, streaming, near real-time);

O Que Faz Você se Destacar:

  • Ter definido padrões ou arquiteturas de dados utilizados por mais de um time ou produto;
  • Experiência com governança de dados, incluindo qualidade, lineage, versionamento e auditoria;
  • Histórico de decisões técnicas que impactaram custo, escalabilidade ou confiabilidade da plataforma de dados;
  • Vivência em ambientes regulados (financeiro, crédito, risco, compliance ou similares);
  • Capacidade de traduzir problemas complexos de negócio em soluções de dados simples, escaláveis e sustentáveis.

title: Product Designer
description:
At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We are a leading end-to-end development consultancy for digital transformation across various markets, growing sustainably since day one. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference.

About The Opportunity

We are looking for a Product Designer to join a fast-paced, product-driven environment focused on building innovative digital experiences in the data and financial technology space.

In this role, you will design end-to-end product experiences for a platform that redefines how users interact with and manage their data. You will work on complex, first-of-their-kind solutions, translating concepts such as data ownership, privacy, and monetization into intuitive, user-friendly interfaces for both consumers and businesses.

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end design process, from discovery and research to delivery and developer handoff.
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and validation to inform design decisions.
  • Translate complex concepts into clear, intuitive, and accessible user experiences.
  • Collaborate closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to align vision and execution.
  • Create and iterate on wireframes, prototypes, and user flows based on feedback and data.
  • Contribute to and maintain a Design System across web and mobile platforms.
  • Ensure consistency, usability, and high-quality visual design across all touchpoints.
  • Support the creation of marketing and web assets aligned with brand guidelines.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong experience in Product Design with a portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product work.
  • Proficiency in Figma for design, prototyping, and developer handoff.
  • Ability to simplify complex systems and concepts into intuitive user experiences.
  • Hands-on experience with user research, discovery, and validation methods.
  • Experience building and evolving Design Systems in collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Ability to work independently in high-ambiguity, fast-paced environments.
  • Strong collaboration skills and a user-centered mindset.
  • Experience using tools such as user journey mapping, flow diagrams, and prototyping techniques.
  • Understanding of different levels of design fidelity, from low-fidelity concepts to production-ready designs.
  • Advanced to Fluent level of English (mandatory).

Nice To Have Skills

  • Experience with Webflow or Framer for marketing or institutional websites.
  • Background in AI, privacy, or data-related products.
  • Experience designing native mobile applications (iOS and Android).
  • Experience working on products in early-stage or product-market fit environments.

Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: ANALISTA DE COMPLIANCE PL
description:
Nosso time de Compliance e Riscos

Ser uma Pessoa de Compliance na Ayvens, ter engajamento, compromisso e responsabilidade com os processos, áreas, alta direção e clientes, auxiliando na revisão dos riscos e mitigantes e colaborando para uma cultura de compliance cada vez mais presente.

Quais são as responsabilidades da posição:

Será um profissional que atuará na segunda linha de defesa em Compliance. O analista será responsável por analisar a due diligence de clientes e fornecedores, fazer a análise crítica dos processos, controles, planos de ação e incidentes relacionados à riscos de Compliance (Corrupção, Conflito de interesses, denúncias, sanções) diretamente com a primeira linha de defesa, trazendo desafios construtivos para as áreas. O analista também atuará em assuntos regulatórios (banco central), avaliando e atuando nos planos de ação referentes aos regulamentos aplicáveis à empresa. O analista também auxiliará a gerente no suporte às auditorias internas, execução de comitês e levantamento de indicadores de compliance (KPIs). Um grande diferencial para a vaga é o conhecimento e experiência na legislação de proteção de dados pessoais (LGPD).

Imprescindível inglês avançado / fluente na escrita, leitura e fala, pois muitos e-mails e reuniões são em inglês.

Este profissional precisa ter habilidades técnicas e “soft skills”: pensamento crítico, resiliência, compromisso com as entregas e prazos, organização de entregáveis, autonomia para entender os processos e sistemas da empresa, reportando ao gerente e ao diretor.

Aspectos comportamentais:

  • Pensamento crítico é essencial;

  • Organização;
  • Cumprimento de prazos;

Conheça Nosso processo:

O processo seletivo se inicia na candidatura e, para algumas oportunidades, há a aplicação de alguns testes. O tempo do processo é flexível.

Os grupos de diversidade (afinidade) são iniciativas fundamentais no grupo SG, estabelecidos para fomentar um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e inclusivo, onde igualdade, equidade e respeito são primordiais. title: Technical Solution Manager (Energy Storage)
description:
Key Responsibilities

1. Solution Design & Optimization

• Lead the design of energy storage solutions across grid-side, generation-side (renewable + storage), and standalone/shared energy storage power stations

• Develop integrated system solutions covering PCS, EMS, BMS, and substation systems

• Analyze grid dispatch requirements and technical challenges in renewable grid integration

2. Tendering & Bidding Support

• Take the lead in large-scale energy storage project tenders

• Prepare technical proposals, including equipment selection, system topology design, and technical deviation analysis

• Ensure compliance, competitiveness, and technical excellence of proposals

3. Customized Project Development

• Evaluate system integration solutions for utility-scale storage projects

• Conduct electrical calculations and simulation analysis for various applications (frequency regulation, peak shaving, black start, etc.)

• Support sales teams in cost estimation and pricing strategy at project level

4. Full Lifecycle Technical Management

• Support project execution from design through construction and delivery

• Resolve technical issues related to electrical interfaces, communication protocols, and grid integration

• Provide technical support during operation & maintenance phases

5. Policy & Market Insights

• Track regional energy storage policies (capacity compensation, spot market rules, grid connection requirements, etc.)

• Analyze market dynamics and regional characteristics

• Contribute to white papers and technical roadmap reports for grid-side energy storage

6. Project Development Enablement

• Develop technical documentation such as:

• Utility-scale ESS development guidelines

• Grid connection FAQs

• Delivery & acceptance SOPs

• Deliver technical training to sales and project teams to accelerate commercialization

7. Competitive Analysis

• Benchmark leading competitors (e.g., Sungrow, HyperStrong)

• Conduct SWOT analysis and provide strategic insights

• Support product evolution in areas such as high-voltage cascade systems and liquid cooling technologies

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree or above in Power Systems, Electrical Engineering, High Voltage Engineering, or related fields

• Minimum 3+ years of experience in the energy storage industry

• Proven experience supporting utility-scale (100MWh+) energy storage projects is preferred

Technical Expertise

• Strong knowledge of primary and secondary electrical design for energy storage systems

• Familiarity with protection systems, grid compliance testing, and SCADA/communication protocols

• Experience with power system analysis; proficiency in simulation tools such as PSCAD or ETAP is a plus

Soft Skills

• Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills

• Ability to represent the company in technical reviews with grid operators, EPCs, and clients

Documentation Skills

• Excellent technical writing skills with the ability to produce structured, high-quality proposals and reports

title: Analista de Logística JR
description:
A GESTAMP é uma multinacional espanhola dedicada ao design, desenvolvimento e fabricação de componentes metálicos automotivos. Trabalhamos para servir com excelência nossos clientes e sociedade, com veículos cada vez mais eficientes e seguros, e buscamos talentos que compartilhem da mesma visão e ambição.

Somos inclusivos, aqui todas as pessoas são bem-vindas.

Analista de Logística JR

Gestamp Taubaté

Resumo das atividades:

Planejamento e Controle da Produção:

  • Planejar e monitorar o cronograma de produção, assegurando o atendimento às demandas.
  • Garantir o equilíbrio entre a capacidade produtiva e os prazos acordados com clientes internos e externos.

Acompanhamento e Análise de Dados:

  • Monitorar indicadores-chave, como eficiência produtiva, lead time e cumprimento de prazos.
  • Analisar desvios no planejamento e propor ações corretivas.

Interface Multidepartamental:

  • Colaborar com áreas como produção, logística e comercial para alinhar demandas e cronogramas.
  • Ajustar o planejamento de produção em resposta a mudanças na demanda ou problemas operacionais.

Geração de Relatórios e Insights:

  • Elaborar relatórios sobre desempenho produtivo e apresentar análises para suporte à tomada de decisão.

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Conhecimento em sistemas ERP (SAP, Oracle) e ferramentas de planejamento de produção.
  • Habilidade em análise de dados e elaboração de relatórios gerenciais.
  • Ensino Superior completo em áreas correlacionadas a atividade.

Desejável:

  • Pós graduação em Planejamento de produção, logística ou gestão industrial.

description:

title: Analista de Infraestrutura Sênior (Consultor de Redes/Segurança)
description:
Função: Analista de Infraestrutura Sênior (Consultor de Redes/Segurança)

Your day at NTT DATA

A NTT DATA Inc. é uma empresa multinacional de tecnologia que integra, dentre seus serviços, o desenvolvimento de software, segurança, cloud e, principalmente, infraestrutura de TI. Estamos, segundo o Great Place to Work, dentre as melhores empresas de Tecnologia para se trabalhar no Brasil. Temos uma cultura de trabalho inclusiva e prezamos muito pela liberdade de melhorar processos, pela flexibilidade e pelo respeito às pessoas!

Para que juntos possamos fazer grandes coisas, a NTT DATA Inc. acredita e apoia a diversidade em sua totalidade. Dessa forma, nossa empresa é aberta para todos, independentemente de deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça, etnia, idade, origem ou estética. #HereYouCan

What You'll Be Doing

Como Analista de Infraestrutura Sênior , você desempenhará um papel fundamental na equipe de Operações, sendo responsável pela análise do ambiente de redes e segurança dos nossos clientes, com o objetivo de apoiar consultivamente para propor melhorias e recomendar mudanças.

Sua contribuição será essencial para manter a infraestrutura de rede funcionando de forma eficiente, permitindo que nossos clientes aproveitem ao máximo suas tecnologias e alcancem seus objetivos comerciais.

  • Horário de Trabalho: Comercial
  • Modalidade de Trabalho: Remoto (Com visitas pontuais – Escritório Alphaville)

Quais serão suas responsabilidades?

  • Possuir experiência comprovada em implementação e suporte de soluções de Network e Security, além de um perfil consultivo para auxiliar nossos clientes na tomada de decisões estratégicas relacionadas à infraestrutura.
  • Realização da documentação de assesment aos ambientes de cliente, apontando recursos previstos, principais pontos de melhorias, riscos e vulnerabilidades;
  • Apoiar eventualmente na atuação em incidentes e resoluções de problemas;
  • Eventuais acompanhamentos de implantações e entregas técnicas de projetos de média e alta complexidade;
  • Preparação e realização de apresentações e demonstrações de produtos, arquitetura e pontos de melhorias;
  • Contribuir com conhecimento nas verticais de atuação e fazer recomendações para o desenvolvimento de novos serviços do nosso go-to-market .

O que esperamos que você possua?

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Telecomunicações, Engenharia de Redes ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Conhecimento aprofundado das operações do dia-a-dia incluindo todas as nuances de infraestrutura de rede e segurança;
  • Proficiência em protocolos de rede, roteamento, switches e configurações de firewall;
  • Compreensão dos princípios de design e arquitetura de Network e Security;
  • Conhecimento em soluções de segurança, como firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN, autenticação, etc;
  • Certificação CCNP Enterprise/Security, Palo Alto PCNSE/NGFW Engineer;
  • Inglês avançado, capaz de se comunicar com cliente e suporte do fabricante.

O que nós oferecemos?

  • Vaga remota
  • Contratação modelo CLT
  • Seu equipamento de trabalho
  • Vale-transporte
  • Vale-refeição/alimentação
  • Auxílio home-office
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico para você e sua família
  • ✨ Seguro de vida em grupo
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR) anual
  • Convênio farmácia
  • Totalpass (convênio academia)
  • Cesta maternidade e licença paternidade estendida
  • Day off de aniversário
  • Oportunidade de participar de ações sociais
  • Incentivo a educação e treinamentos
  • Uma cultura de trabalho inclusiva, onde juntos fazemos grandes coisas!

Para entender como tratamos os seus dados pessoais, por favor, acesse nosso Aviso de Privacidade de Recrutamento .

title: Gerente financeiro
description:
Estamos conduzindo um processo seletivo para uma indústria multinacional para a região da Grande Porto Alegre e buscamos um(a) Gerente Financeiro para atuar em posição de liderança, com forte interface com áreas do negócio e reporte para estrutura global. As principais responsabilidades deste profissional serão:

– Liderar a área financeira, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos de fechamento mensal e anual, bem como a qualidade das informações financeiras reportadas;

– Atuar na análise de desempenho financeiro da operação, incluindo Demonstração de Resultados (P&L) e Balanço Patrimonial, apoiando a tomada de decisão da liderança;

– Conduzir processos de orçamento e forecast, acompanhando resultados e propondo ajustes junto às áreas envolvidas;

– Desmembrar e analisar resultados financeiros por unidades de negócio, apoiando gestores na tomada de decisões estratégicas;

– Gerenciar processos financeiros operacionais, incluindo contas a pagar, contas a receber, conciliações e gestão de caixa;

– Atuar no relacionamento com instituições financeiras, incluindo operações bancárias e câmbio;

– Acompanhar e apoiar processos administrativos da operação, como gestão de seguros, licenças e orçamento de recursos de TI;

– Liderar e desenvolver a equipe financeira local, garantindo alinhamento com as diretrizes da organização;

– Impulsionar iniciativas de digitalização e automação de processos financeiros;

– Interagir com a estrutura regional e global, participando de reuniões e reportes em inglês.

Buscamos profissionais com sólida experiência na área financeira, vivência em ambiente corporativo estruturado e forte capacidade analítica. É importante ter perfil de liderança, boa comunicação e facilidade de interação com diferentes áreas da empresa.

Inglês avançado/fluente é essencial para a posição.

title: Coordenador de Canais
description:
A Blockbit, maior fabricante brasileira de soluções de cibersegurança, busca um(a) Coordenador de Canais para acelerar o crescimento do nosso ecossistema de parceiros (revendas, MSPs, integradores e distribuidores), com foco no credenciamento de canais qualificados, capacitação, governança e performance comercial por canal.

Responsabilidades

· Desenvolver e executar a estratégia de canais (recrutamento, segmentação, cobertura geográfica, metas e plano de crescimento)

· Gerenciar carteira de parceiros e distribuidores, conduzindo reuniões de acompanhamento, planejamento, capacitação e ações conjuntas de geração de demanda

· Definir e operar processos de onboarding, capacitação e certificação de parceiros (treinamentos, materiais e playbooks)

· Construir e manter o programa de canais (regras de registro de oportunidades, níveis de parceria e políticas comerciais)

· Atuar junto ao time de vendas e pré-vendas para suportar oportunidades de negócios e acelerar ciclos de vendas via canal

· Monitorar indicadores (pipeline, reuniões, conversão, ticket médio, churn/renovações quando aplicável) e reportar forecast por canal

· Mapear oportunidades de co-marketing e co-selling, alinhando campanhas e eventos com o marketing

· Coletar feedback do ecossistema e contribuir para melhorias de produto, proposta de valor e competitividade.

Requisitos

· Ensino superior completo (Administração, Marketing, TI ou correlatos)

· Experiência em gestão de canais no mercado de tecnologia, preferencialmente cibersegurança, redes ou cloud

· Vivência com estruturação de programa de parceiros, políticas comerciais e gestão de revendedores e/ou distribuidores

· Habilidade de negociação e relacionamento, com atuação orientada a metas e performance

· Capacidade analítica para gestão de KPIs e previsibilidade de resultados (CRM/BI).

· Inglês (diferencial).

O que oferecemos

· Vale-refeição ou vale-alimentação

· Vale-transporte

· Plano de saúde e odontológico

· Auxílio home office

· Remuneração variável (bônus/comissão) conforme política de canais

· Oportunidade de crescimento em empresa líder em cibersegurança

· Ambiente de alta performance com desenvolvimento contínuo

Se você quer atuar no centro da transformação da cibersegurança e liderar crescimento em um mercado em rápida expansão,  candidate-se a esta vaga e tenha a oportunidade de construir com a Blockbit a proteção do futuro digital das empresas brasileiras.

E qual será a sua missão na Framework?

  • Engenharia de Requisitos: Levantar, analisar e documentar requisitos funcionais e não funcionais, garantindo que as regras de negócio estejam claras para o time de engenharia.
  • Discovery & Estratégia: Liderar o processo de descoberta de produto, validando hipóteses e desenhando soluções que resolvam dores reais do usuário.
  • Gestão de RFPs e Planos: Estruturar documentos técnicos para concorrência de fornecedores (RFP) e elaborar planos de projeto com marcos (milestones) e cronogramas de entrega.
  • Acompanhamento de Squads: Atuar no dia a dia do desenvolvimento, facilitando rituais, removendo impedimentos e garantindo a saúde do fluxo de trabalho.
  • Gestão de Frameworks: Adaptar o uso de Scrum, Kanban ou Scrumban de acordo com o desafio e a maturidade do time.
  • Priorização de Valor: Gerenciar e refinar o backlog continuamente, utilizando frameworks de priorização baseados em dados e ROI.

O que é preciso para fazer parte do time?

  • Domínio de Agilidade: Experiência prática em Scrum, Kanban e acompanhamento de Squads multidisciplinares.
  • Escrita Técnica: Sólida experiência em escrita de requisitos, User Stories e critérios de aceite detalhados.
  • Visão de Projetos: Capacidade de estruturar Planos de Projeto (cronogramas, riscos e dependências) e processos de RFP.
  • Discovery: Vivência em metodologias de descoberta (Design Thinking, Inception ou similares).
  • Ferramental: Domínio de ferramentas de gestão de backlog (Azure DevOps).

Será um diferencial se você:

  • Varejo Digital: Experiência com produtos de E-commerce, Meios de Pagamento ou Logística.
  • Visão Sistêmica: Conhecimento básico em APIs, integrações e arquitetura de sistemas.
  • Gestão Híbrida: Experiência em alinhar o desenvolvimento ágil a prazos e cronogramas executivos/tradicionais.
  • Gestão de Fornecedores: Experiência direta no acompanhamento de parceiros contratados via RFP.

A NOSSA EVOLUÇÃO É CRESCENTE!

E, para acompanhar esse crescimento, precisamos de pessoas que agreguem propondo ideias, soluções e desafios!

Gostou da oportunidade? Vamos juntos e faça parte da nossa história! #vempraframe

Somos plurais por natureza, um grupo diverso em negócios e pessoas. Acreditamos que as diferenças somam e movimentam, e é por isso que o Grupo SADA quer conhecer você. Todas as nossas vagas são extensivas as Pessoas com Deficiência e profissionais reabilitados do INSS. Quem sabe alguma oportunidade combina com você.

A oportunidade é ideal para profissionais que hoje atuam como Assistente Fiscal , mas que já estão preparados para dar o próximo passo na carreira e assumir responsabilidades mais estratégicas.

O(a) profissional será responsável por apoiar e executar atividades fiscais essenciais, garantindo o cumprimento das obrigações principais e acessórias , a organização e análise de documentos, além de contribuir para a conformidade tributária e a eficiência dos processos internos.

Buscamos alguém proativo, detalhista, organizado e com maturidade técnica para evoluir rapidamente dentro da área, aprendendo e assumindo novas demandas com autonomia.

Oportunidade: Analista Fiscal Júnior

Local: Betim / MG

Modelo de Trabalho: 100% Presencial

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Executar atividades relacionadas às obrigações fiscais principais e acessórias ;
  • Realizar apurações de tributos conforme legislação vigente;
  • Transmitir declarações aos órgãos competentes dentro dos prazos legais;
  • Assegurar conformidade dos processos fiscais com normas internas e legislação;
  • Apoiar a equipe em demandas fiscais e rotinas contábeis relacionadas.

REQUISITOS NECESSÁRIOS

✅ Ensino superior em andamento ou concluído em Ciências Contábeis ou Administração ;

✅ Experiência prévia na rotina fiscal , incluindo lançamento, conferência e organização de documentos;

✅ Perfil organizado , analítico e atento aos detalhes ;

✅ Boa gestão do tempo , capacidade de autogerenciamento e trabalho colaborativo ;

✅ Comunicação clara, postura profissional e facilidade para lidar com diferentes áreas;

✅ Conhecimentos básicos de Excel e sistemas de gestão.

REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS

✅ Vivência no segmento de transporte e logística ;

✅ Conhecimento no sistema DATASUL (diferencial importante);

✅ Familiaridade com legislação fiscal , escrituração e processos de notas fiscais.

Venha fazer parte dessa história!

Se você deseja consolidar sua evolução profissional e atuar como Analista Fiscal Júnior em um ambiente que incentiva desenvolvimento, esta vaga é a sua oportunidade!

Candidate-se e contribua para fortalecer a marca, os resultados e a cultura do Grupo SADA .

NOSSA HISTÓRIA

Para contar a história do nosso grupo empresarial precisamos voltar ao Brasil dos anos 70, quando um jovem visionário desembarcava da Europa trazendo objetivos bem audaciosos. Ali, iniciava a trajetória da SADA, com a implantação de uma pequena transportadora na região metropolitana de Belo Horizonte.

Fundada em 4 de agosto de 1976, na cidade de Contagem, em Minas Gerais, a SADA Transportes e Armazéns S/A é criada, a partir da necessidade de atender as demandas de armazenagem e distribuição automobilística no país.

Sete anos depois, em 1983, a empresa é transferida para Betim em um terreno de cerca de 31 mil metros quadrados, 23 vezes menor que a área ocupada pela empresa atualmente.

“Ainda muito jovem, cheguei aqui vindo da Itália com a tarefa de montar a SADA no Brasil junto com a chegada da Fiat”, conta Vittorio Medioli , fundador presidente do Grupo SADA.

Assim como seu precursor, a origem do nome SADA também é italiana:

TRADIÇÃO EM CRESCER

Apesar das dificuldades políticas e econômicas da época, a empresa estabeleceu uma tradição em crescer, valorizando o trabalho em equipe e as habilidades individuais dos colaboradores em um ambiente onde todos se sentem orgulhosos de construir uma história de solidez e grandes conquistas.

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
ABOUT US

, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.

Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.

Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.

Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.

THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.

What You’ll Do

  • Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
  • Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
  • UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
  • Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
  • Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
  • Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.

WHAT IT TAKES

  • The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
  • The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
  • The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
  • The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
  • The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
  • The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.

Key Skills

  • Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.
  • Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.
  • AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.
  • Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.
  • Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.
  • Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
  • Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.

Be fully aligned with our core values:

Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
  • Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.

OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

Fundada no Brasil em 2020, com sede em São Paulo, a Gruen conta com um time de engenharia atuando tanto localmente quanto na Alemanha o que assegura o desenvolvimento do processo mais eficiente para cada projeto. Nossa missão é entregar a melhor tecnologia para purificação de biogás com o menor consumo de energia entre todos os processos disponíveis no mercado.

Nossas soluções são específicas e feitas sob medida de acordo com a necessidade dos nossos clientes: pré-tratamento do gás, remoção de CO2 e N2, optional CO2 capture and storage ou liquefação, Liquefação de CH4 ou compressão de 250bar – desde o projeto inicial até a gestão da operação da planta, garantindo satisfação total de nossos clientes.

Fabricação e assistência técnica locais resultam em redução de custo e aumento de eficiência.

Soluções para contratos de manutenção e operação das plantas viabilizam a redução da complexidade e de custos.

title: Talent Data Analyst
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the role:

We are looking for a Talent Data Analyst to join our Talent team. This professional will be responsible for taking raw information – numbers or qualitative data sets – and constructing narratives that help our business colleagues to make better decisions. The primary goal of this position is to take large volumes of complex data from our Talent team, extract insights, and help solve problems.

Key responsibilities:

- Understand the Talent funnel and architect a Data solution from scratch, including the definition of KPIs and metrics.

- Work with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, identifying and querying data sources to get the required data.

- Present and gather feedback from stakeholders.

- Deploy data, reports, and dashboards to Data Analysis tools, developing reports according to analyst-defined specifications.

- Maintain and document the operational environment.

Benefits:

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Tech Lead DevOps (Especialista em Plataforma/Cloud)
description:

Este profissional terá papel fundamental na construção, sustentação e melhoria contínua da nossa infraestrutura cloud, pipelines de integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD) e práticas de segurança integradas ao ciclo de desenvolvimento.

A pessoa atuará diretamente na administração e evolução de ambientes em Google Cloud Platform (GCP) , além de projetar e manter pipelines utilizando Azure DevOps , garantindo processos de entrega mais rápidos, seguros e confiáveis. Também será responsável por implementar práticas de DevSecOps , promovendo automação, observabilidade e governança em toda a jornada de desenvolvimento e operação das aplicações.

Buscamos alguém com mentalidade voltada para automação, qualidade e segurança , capaz de atuar de forma colaborativa com times de desenvolvimento, arquitetura e segurança, apoiando na adoção de boas práticas de cloud e engenharia de plataforma.

Se você gosta de resolver problemas complexos, trabalhar com tecnologias modernas de infraestrutura e contribuir para ambientes escaláveis, resilientes e seguros, essa oportunidade é para você.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Projetar, implementar e manter pipelines de CI/CD utilizando Azure DevOps, garantindo qualidade e automação no ciclo de desenvolvimento e entrega de software;
  • Administrar, evoluir e otimizar ambientes em Google Cloud Platform (GCP), garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e alta disponibilidade das aplicações;
  • Implementar práticas de DevSecOps, integrando ferramentas e processos de segurança ao pipeline de desenvolvimento e entrega contínua;
  • Gerenciar e evoluir infraestrutura como código (IaC), utilizando ferramentas como Terraform ou similares para provisionamento automatizado de ambientes;
  • Implementar e manter soluções de monitoramento, observabilidade e logging, garantindo visibilidade e performance dos sistemas;
  • Automatizar processos de provisionamento, configuração e deploy de aplicações em ambientes cloud;
  • Garantir conformidade com políticas de segurança, governança e boas práticas de arquitetura em nuvem;
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento e arquitetura na adoção de práticas modernas de cloud, automação e segurança;
  • Atuar na identificação, análise e resolução de incidentes e problemas relacionados à infraestrutura e pipelines.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência sólida com Google Cloud Platform (GCP) , incluindo serviços como: Compute Engine, GKE (Kubernetes), Cloud Run, IAM, VPC, Cloud Storage;
  • Domínio de Azure DevOps , incluindo: Pipelines YAML, Repositórios, Boards, Artifacts;
  • Experiência com containers e orquestração , utilizando Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Experiência com infraestrutura como código (IaC) , utilizando Terraform ou ferramentas similares;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de colaboração e gestão como Jira e Confluence;
  • Conhecimento e experiência com ferramentas de segurança de aplicações , como SAST, DAST, SCA, gestão de vulnerabilidades e Secrets Management;
  • Conhecimento em Linux e experiência com scripting (Bash, PowerShell ou Python);
  • Experiência com Git e controle de versionamento .

Consideramos como um diferencial:

  • Certificações em GCP (ex.: Professional Cloud Architect, DevOps Engineer);
  • Certificação Kubernetes (CKA ou CKAD);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog e Grafana;
  • Experiência em ambientes multi-cloud .

Perfil comportamental:

  • Mentalidade voltada para automação e melhoria contínua;
  • Forte foco em segurança e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma consultiva com times técnicos;
  • Perfil analítico e orientado à resolução de problemas;
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração entre áreas.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
ABOUT COTY

Coty is one of the world’s largest beauty companies, with an iconic portfolio of fragrance, color cosmetics, skin care, and body care brands.

At Coty, we celebrate and nurture a culture of kindness. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and believe that beauty lies in diversity. We are committed to building an inclusive environment where all talents can shine and where different perspectives drive innovation and growth.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a highly skilled Talent Acquisition Specialist to lead end-to-end recruitment processes for strategic and complex roles across LATAM.

This position requires strong business acumen, stakeholder influence, and deep expertise in sourcing and assessment methodologies. You will act as a trusted advisor to leaders, ensuring excellence in delivery, data-driven decision-making, and an outstanding candidate experience.

This is an individual contributor role with high regional exposure and strong interaction with global stakeholders.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead full-cycle recruitment for strategic and complex positions across LATAM markets;
  • Partner closely with senior leaders and hiring managers, acting as a talent advisor and influencing hiring decisions;
  • Conduct structured and competency-based interviews, ensuring high-quality assessment and cultural alignment;
  • Design and execute proactive sourcing strategies, leveraging talent mapping and headhunting techniques;
  • Drive diverse talent pipelines aligned with DE&I priorities;
  • Monitor and analyze recruitment KPIs, generating insights to continuously improve processes and hiring outcomes;
  • Ensure effective use of ATS systems and full compliance with internal policies and local labor legislation;
  • Contribute to Employer Branding and regional talent initiatives in partnership with global teams.

REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or related fields;
  • Fluent English and Spanish (mandatory for regional scope and stakeholder interaction);
  • +5 years of solid experience in Talent Acquisition, ideally with regional LATAM exposure;
  • Strong expertise in competency-based interviewing, talent mapping, and sourcing tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS, etc.);
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable insights;
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills;
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.

title: Auditor Sênior
description:
Main responsibilities of the position:

Job Summary:

The Senior Auditor within Global Internal Audit (GIA) executes independent, objective assurance and advisory activities to assess the effectiveness of the Bank’s governance, risk management, and internal control processes. This hands‑on role supports audit engagements across all phases, including planning, risk assessment, fieldwork, reporting, and issue validation, and may lead assigned audit components or workstreams. The Senior Auditor is responsible for delivering assigned audit activities and documentation, identifying risks and control gaps, developing clear and actionable recommendations, and supporting the Audit In‑Charge (AIC) and Audit Manager with engagement execution, coordination, and stakeholder communication.

Major Responsibilities:

  • Execute risk‑based internal audit engagements in accordance with the IIA’s International Professional Practices Framework (IPPF), GIA Methodology, and applicable banking regulatory expectations.
  • Assess the design and operating effectiveness of governance, risk management, and internal control processes across banking products, operations, and support functions.
  • Apply professional skepticism and personal accountability to identify control weaknesses, assess root causes, and evaluate the impact on risk and risk management practices.
  • Generate insightful, well‑articulated audit observations that clearly convey significance, risk impact, and management implications, and report audit findings and issues to Audit Management.
  • Prepare and maintain high‑quality, stand‑alone audit documentation and workpapers that fully support audit conclusions and enable independent re‑performance.
  • Support the Audit In‑Charge (AIC) and Audit Manager with engagement execution, issue validation, and effective communication with management and key stakeholders.
  • Operate with an innovative and flexible mindset by continuously identifying opportunities to enhance audit consistency, efficiency, quality, and overall value.
  • Maintain effective working relationships with business, risk, and compliance partners while preserving independence and objectivity.

Desired experience for the role:

  • 4+ years of progressive experience in internal audit, external audit, risk management, or compliance, preferably within banking or financial services.
  • Experience executing risk‑based internal audit engagements end‑to‑end, including planning, fieldwork, reporting, and issue validation.
  • Hands‑on experience evaluating the design and operating effectiveness of internal controls across banking products, operations, and support functions.
  • Experience applying IIA IPPF standards and working within environments subject to banking regulatory oversight.
  • Experience producing stand‑alone audit documentation and workpapers that support conclusions and enable independent re‑performance.
  • Experience developing and reporting clear, risk‑focused audit observations that articulate significance, root cause, and impact on risk and risk management practices.

Specific knowledge, skills, and certifications required for the role:

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills, required due to audit methodology, documentation, and regular interaction with global and local stakeholders conducted in English.
  • CIA preferred; CISA, CRMA, CRC, CPA-10, CPA-20 or equivalent professional certification is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of internal audit principles, risk‑based auditing, and internal control frameworks within a banking environment.
  • Ability to apply professional skepticism, sound judgment, and personal accountability when evaluating risks and controls.
  • Capability to develop clear, risk‑focused audit observations and communicate issues effectively to Audit Management and stakeholders.
  • Ability to prepare high‑quality, stand‑alone audit documentation that supports conclusions and enables independent re‑performance.
  • 'Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
  • Advanced degree (e.g., MBA or Master’s in Accounting/Finance) is a plus.
